definitions.explanation: A wary, guarded attitude toward a person, animal or situation one does not yet trust. Used of people and of animals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野良猫|のらねこ}→野良猫：14440_noraneko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{警戒心|けいかいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
⟦{初対面|しょたいめん}→初対面：07306_shotaimen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{警戒心|けいかいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}いて→抱く：02010_idaku⟧しまう。
examples.english: I tend to be on my guard with people I've just met.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優|やさ}しく→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦{話|はな}しかけている→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧うち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{警戒心|けいかいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→〜ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{解|と}けて→解ける：04371_tokeru⟧いった。
examples.english: As I kept talking to the child gently, the child's wariness gradually melted away.

notes:
From ⟦{警戒|けいかい}→警戒：14224_keikai⟧ (caution, vigilance) + {心|しん} (mind, feeling).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {警戒心|けいかいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: very wary, suspicious
- {警戒心|けいかいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抱|いだ}く→抱く：02010_idaku⟧: to feel wary
- {警戒心|けいかいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧: to drop one's guard
- {警戒心|けいかいしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: not cautious enough
